description: PANTHERA is a multidisciplinary team in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, building FIREWATCH 360, an intelligent platform harmonising NASA MODIS and VIIRS active-fire data to uncover seasonal patterns, detect anomalous burning activity and support environmental decision-making. Based in Nigeria, designed for global scale. Seeking: Python developers, remote sensing analysts, GIS specialists, web developers, data viz designers and science communicators.
